newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Offer in Sri Lanka diesel/jet at low 58-ct premium.
newsitem.headline: Offer in Sri Lanka diesel/jet at low 58-ct premium.

text.p: French oil firm Total has made the lowest offer of 58 cents per barrel over Singapore spot quotes into Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp's (CPC) tender to buy diesel and jet fuel, a CPC source said on Thursday.
The offer price for both products were for February 13-14 delivery, on a cost-and-freight (c&f) basis to Colombo.
The tender sought 180,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and 120,000 barrels of jet fuel.
The tender, which attracted five offers, closed on January 29 and would be awarded this evening, the source said.
In its previous tender, CPC bought 180,000 barrels of diesel at 69 cents per barrel premium and 120,000 barrels of jet fuel at a 64-cent premium from Shell for February 4-5 delivery, c&f Colombo.
